notes.title: Please don't hurt me! - Aracore update 1.4
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129711/69b1a300422de51a94b3796e9c761793167d98a7.png"]


Additional mission added!


After analysing ongoing pilot feedback, Haaris has decided to take new pilots under his wing. After his scans revealed a potential asteroid strike on Ara base, Haaris now offers to take new pilots on a mining mission with the hopes of avoiding chaos!

Added a new mining mission!

After the tutorial stage, players may now opt to go on a new mission with Haaris

This mission allows players to skip the asteroid strike and clean-up missions

Players may choose the (more clearly labelled) more difficult mission if they're sadists

Added an 'engine power' key: hold for finer movement control

Added an in-game link to the DIscord channel: join if you want to get involved in the game!

Updated dialogue


Join the Discord!
If you want to be involved in development, get access to the beta-version of the full game (now around 80% complete), and give your own suggestions, join the El Crabo Grande Game Discord


Next Update
Some players are having issues with sound. If you have no sound or no music (which is a terrible shame, as the music is awesome), please post in the discussion board or Discord and I'll find a fix, which may involve ripping out the current sound engine and replacing it.

Any feedback on the changes is always welcome!

notes.title: AraCore Astromining Ventures NextFest Demo 1.2 Update
notes.notes:
Updated the demo to include some features of the full game:

New game mode: 'Challenge mode' with 18 micro-missions to test your mining skills

New Game mode: 'Free Mode' with two large stages to explore 

Both new game modes contain new ships and technologies for the player to experiment with

Input will default to gamepad or keyboard depending on what you press on the main menu

Direct link to steam community to feedback added to menu menu and pause menu



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129711/bbd354ff1235dfc0813c0b183ed631783200e5d4.png"]

New achievements have been added for completing all challenges!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129711/e41ef1edce81d22649071bac2cd2d80b043f3e37.png"]

notes.title: AraCore Astromining Ventures Demo 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Updated the demo:

Added a short tutorial stage for players to familiarise themselves with the drone controls before chaos kicks in
Allowed player to skip tutorial, or just fail it and move on anyway
Altered Stage 3 (Ice Breaker) end condition to include docking with surveyor ship
Added new dialogue for several rare situations when the player does strange combitations of things


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129711/25ced15b89b8011ea867901ac62e94fe328dcc33.png

Fixed bugs relating to starting Stage 4 (Noble Pursuits) with only one drone
Fixed collision issues with grapple on some objects
